integrity: Exact threshold signs, finite combinatorial completeness and arithmetic are documented in a standalone Python checker. The self-contained proof uses these finite checks only for periods at most five; no worldwide publication-priority guarantee or independent certification is implied.
scientific_limitations: The complete short-period census is limited to c=1+b, b=1/4, and 0<d<h; no periods greater than five, global basin sizes, or nonlinear attractors are classified. The open interval for 0<b<b_* is a sufficient coexistence region, not a full parameter-space partition. An independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
title: A sharp weak-sentiment five-cycle threshold in a three-zone market map
